title: C-Bounce releases a new single "Swish Mode"
htmlContent:
C-Bounce presents a new track called "Swish Mode," a record that truly lives up to the name, with a sound that can not to be stopped. It’s a music experience that makes you want to dive into their whole catalog, and become invested in these sure stars with a must hear sound the world will love. The production sets a tone that feels good to hear, as the vocals feel good to the spirit. Delivering the powerful writing, with impressive singing skills that help it all click to make it a record that people will enjoy all over the world.
